title: Add Kani-backed L2 bounded checking with type-driven bound inference

comments.author: Yffe
comments.content: Implement L2 Kani-backed bounded checking. thermite-lower/src/l2.rs: lower_l2 emits a #[kani::proof] #[kani::unwind(K)] harness per fn, REUSING the L1 executable lowering (spec_sum recursion, combinator loops, expr/stmt forms) for body+spec fns since Kani checks executable Rust. Type-driven bound inference (REQ-2 headline): infer_symbolic_input keys on the Param's Type — &[T]→symbolic [T;N] array + len<=N, scalar→kani::any() — SHAPE-keyed never name-keyed. SLICE_BOUND N=4. unwind_bound SHAPE-keyed on loop kind: while→N+1 (sum=5), unconditional loop→N+2 (binary_search=6). forge/src/kani.rs: run_kani writes a temp cargo crate, spawns real cargo-kani --output-format terse, checks exit status, parses SUCCESSFUL→L2 / FAILED→counterexample / no-summary→KaniOutput err; ENOENT→KaniAbsent. forge check --level l2 runs check_l2_file; default stays L3 (no auto-degrade, #10). Verified vs real cargo kani 0.67.0.

comments.author: Yffe
comments.content: SHIPPED — Kani L2 bounded checking. l2.rs lower_l2 -> Kani harness (reuses L1 exec lowering; bounded symbolic slice; shape-keyed bound inference N=4, unwind N+1/N+2). forge/src/kani.rs run_kani -> L2 cert/counterexample; forge check --level l2 (default L3). Critic NO DIVERGENCE: anti-vacuity proven (fresh ens-violating body -> L0+counterexample), under-bound reported (never false pass), shape-keyed, deterministic, kani-absent -> ForgeError. Live: sum/binary_search -> L2. Commit 13db730, workspace 201 tests, clippy/fmt clean. N=4 is doc-authorized; N=8 (§5.2 example) measured feasible (10.7s) = one-const bump if wanted. Not pushed.
